9.    ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
      Cheyenne, establishing the zoning classification of AG - Agricultural for land annexed to
      the City of Cheyenne, located south of East Fox Farm Road, north of East Allison Road
      and east of and adjacent to South College Drive.

 ACTION:

10.   ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
      Cheyenne, changing the zoning classification for land located south of East Fox Farm
      Road, north of East Allison Road and east of and adjacent to South College Drive from AG
      – Agricultural to BP – Business Park.

 ACTION:

11.   ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending Sections 1.4.3, 1.4.4, 2.2.3, 5.1.4, and 5.7.2
      of the Cheyenne Unified Development Code to add and clarify Specified Use Allowances,
      clarify processes for Agricultural Uses and providing definitions.

 ACTION:

12.   ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending Section 6.2.8 of the Cheyenne Unified
      Development Code to allow for unpaved parking in certain site-specific situations.

 ACTION:

13.   ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending Section 6.08.020 of the Municipal Code of
      the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to revise exceptions to restrictions on keeping livestock
      within the City.

 ACTION:

14.   ORDINANCE – 3rd READING – Amending Section 9.12.080 of the Municipal Code of
      the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to allow electric fencing for certain agricultural and
      livestock uses.

 ACTION:

15.   ORDINANCE – 2nd READING – Creating Sections 1.1.8, 1.1.9, and 5.8.9; and amending
      Sections 1.4.3, 4.5.3, and 4.5.4 of the Unified Development Code to clarify requirements
      around establishing uses, including expectations for all construction sites. (SPONSOR –
      DR. RINNE)
